title: Cylindrical base
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a new face and within this face, draw a single loop. Inside this loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates [0.0134, 0.0134] with a radius of 0.0134 units. Scale this 2D sketch by a factor of 0.0268. Rotate the scaled 2D sketch using Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translate it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the 2D sketch along its normal by 0.75 units without extruding in the opposite direction. This operation will generate a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical base will be a length of 0.026785714285714284 units, a width of 0.026785714285714284 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0134, 0.0134).circle(0.0134)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical object
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
r = cylinder

# Display the final model

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0134, 0.0134)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0134)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
